Help.greeting: Hi {name}, how can I help you today?
Help.searchPlaceholder: Ask me a question or describe your issue...
Help.noOrders: You haven't placed any orders yet.
Help.searchResults: Here is what I found for you:
Help.noResultsDesc: I couldn't find any answers for "{query}". Please try rephrasing or contact support.
Help.supportReady: If you need further assistance, our support team is ready to help.
Help.aiResponseHeader: Here is what I found for you:
Help.aiSummary: Based on your query, here is a quick summary:

recommended.q: How do I track my order?
recommended.a: You can track your order in the 'My Orders' section. Click the 'Track' button next to the order for real-time shipping status. We also send email notifications for every update.
The order number is a numeric ID usually starting with #Order. You can find it in the order confirmation email and in the 'My Orders' section inside your account.

recommended.q: How do I cancel my order?
recommended.a: An order can be cancelled within 30 minutes of creation. Go to 'My Orders', find the order, and click 'Cancel Order'. If the order status becomes 'Processing' or 'Shipped', you will have to wait until delivery.

recommended.q: How do I become a merchant / seller?
recommended.a: You can register as a seller from the 'Create Account' page. Simply select 'I am a seller / merchant', fill in your store details, and submit for administration approval.

recommended.q: How do I add a new product to my store?
recommended.a: If you are an approved merchant, go to your Merchant Dashboard, navigate to 'Products', and click 'Add New Product'. Ensure you provide clear images and an accurate description.

recommended.q: How do I process a new order?
recommended.a: When you receive an order, it will appear in the Orders section of your Merchant Dashboard. You can update its status to Processing, and later to Shipped once you hand it to the courier.

order-issues.q: Can I cancel part of my order?
order-issues.a: Yes, you can cancel specific items from the order before they are processed for shipping. Open the order details and choose 'Cancel Item' for the desired product.

order-issues.q: How do I ask for help with an order?
order-issues.a: Select the order from the 'My Orders' section and click 'Get Help'. You will be connected directly with the seller or the official support team via messaging.

order-issues.q: I ordered several products together, why do I only see some of them?
order-issues.a: Mahally is a multi-vendor marketplace. Orders are managed by different sellers separately, so you might receive multiple packages and tracking numbers for one order.

order-issues.q: How do I return a product?
order-issues.a: If your order is eligible for a return, you can initiate a return request from My Orders within 14 days of delivery. Ensure the item is unused and in its original packaging.

buying.q: How do I use a discount code?
buying.a: You can enter the discount code on the checkout page under the 'Payment' section. Click 'Apply Coupon' before completing the purchase.
Absolutely. We use SSL encryption for all transactions and provide Mahally Buyer Protection to guarantee your funds until the order is delivered safely.

buying.q: How do I leave a review?
buying.a: After you receive your order, you can leave a review by going to My Orders, selecting the delivered product, and clicking Write a Review.

shipping.a: Standard shipping within Jordan usually takes 2 to 5 business days. The duration may vary depending on the seller's location.
Express shipping options are available for some products. Look for the 'Express' shipping speed during checkout.

account.q: How do I secure my account?
account.a: We recommend using a strong, unique password and enabling any additional verification options available in account settings.

account.q: Can I save products for later?
account.a: Yes! Just click the heart icon on any product to add it to your Wishlist.

account.q: How do I withdraw my earnings?
account.a: You can request a withdrawal of your available balance directly from your Merchant Dashboard. Navigate to the Withdraw section, enter the amount, and select your payout method.

promotions.a: Promo credits are automatically applied to your cart at checkout for eligible products. You can view your available credits in your profile.

promotions.q: How do I create a discount coupon for my store?
promotions.a: Go to the Coupons section in your Merchant Dashboard. You can set up percentage or fixed discounts, specify expiry dates, and restrict usage limits.

technical.q: The website is slow or not working.
technical.a: Try clearing your browser cache and cookies or using another device. If the problem persists, contact the support team.
